message.content:
\[
0.\overline{2}=\frac{2}{9}, \qquad 0.\overline{6}=\frac{6}{9}
\]

So

\[
a=\frac{2}{9}+\frac{6}{9}=\frac{8}{9}
\]

The reciprocal of \(a\) is

\[
\frac{1}{a}=\frac{1}{8/9}=\frac{9}{8}=1.125
\]

The answer is 1.125.
